Public API surface and exact contracts (Python 3.10):

- Module tank_battle/directions.py:
  - from enum import Enum
  - class Direction(Enum): with exact members N=(0,-1), E=(1,0), S=(0,1), W=(-1,0)
  - Methods:
    - delta(self)->tuple[int,int]: returns self.value
    - left(self)->Direction: return the left-turn enum (N<-W<-S<-E<-N)
    - right(self)->Direction: return the right-turn enum (N->E->S->W->N)
  - Used by Tank.barrel_ahead and Projectile.move; all movement uses Direction.delta() rather than re-implemented mappings.

- Module tank_battle/geometry.py:
  - Class Rect(x:int,y:int,w:int,h:int): immutable value object. Raises ValueError if w<=0 or h<=0. Method contains(px:int,py:int)->bool uses half-open rule: x<=px<x+w and y<=py<y+h.

- Module tank_battle/obstacle.py:
  - Class Obstacle(rect:Rect): encapsulates one Rect via attribute rect.

- Module tank_battle/arena.py:
  - Class Arena(width:int,height:int,obstacles:list[Obstacle]): rejects nonpositive width/height via ValueError. Methods:
    - in_bounds(x:int,y:int)->bool: 0<=x<width and 0<=y<height
    - is_blocked(x:int,y:int)->bool: returns True if out-of-bounds or any obstacle.rect.contains(x,y) is True

- Module tank_battle/tank.py:
  - Class Tank(id:str,name:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,health:int=3,speed:int=1)
  - Public attributes include direction; no alias like dir.
  - Methods:
    - barrel_ahead(self)->tuple[int,int]: compute the next cell in the facing direction using direction.delta()
    - alive(self)->bool: health>0
    - clone(self)->Tank: deep copy value

- Module tank_battle/projectile.py:
  - Class Projectile(pid:int,owner_id:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,speed:int=1) with attribute direction
  - Methods:
    - move(self)->None: advance one unit using direction.delta()
    - clone(self)->Projectile: deep copy value

- Module tank_battle/commands.py:
  - Class Command: instantiable marker; Command has no execute method; no ABC and no @abstractmethod
  - Subclasses:
    - MoveForward(steps:int=1): rejects steps<1 via ValueError
    - RotateLeft(): no arguments
    - RotateRight(): no arguments
    - RotateTo(direction:Direction): stores attribute direction
    - Fire(): no arguments
  - None of these defines execute; polymorphic callbacks are forbidden.

- Module tank_battle/scoring.py:
  - Class ScoreBoard(player_ids:list[str]): initializes hits and kills as {player_id:0 for player_id in player_ids}
  - Methods:
    - record_hit(player_id:str)->None
    - record_kill(player_id:str)->None
    - score(player_id:str)->int defined as score(player_id)=hits+5*kills

- Module tank_battle/game.py:
  - Must literally include: from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire
  - Class Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank])
    - Constructor validates:
      - every tank has a unique (x,y)
      - all tank cells are in-bounds and unblocked by obstacles
      - stores deep immutable initial snapshot of arena and tanks
    - Public mutable attributes: arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id
    - queue_command(self, player_id:str, command:Command)->None: appends (player_id,command) to command_queue without reordering
    - tick(self)->None: deterministic order
      - stable-sort queued commands by player id
      - dispatch solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); command.execute or any other polymorphic call is forbidden
      - Apply commands:
        - MoveForward: attempt steps one cell at a time; stop before moving into out-of-bounds, obstacle, or a live tank cell
        - RotateLeft/RotateRight: change direction accordingly
        - RotateTo: set tank.direction to given direction
        - Fire: if barrel_ahead is free (in-bounds, not obstacle, not occupied by a live tank), spawn Projectile(pid=self.next_projectile_id, owner_id=player_id, x,y=barrel cell, direction=tank.direction), increment next_projectile_id
      - Clear command_queue after applying
      - Process projectiles by pid ascending. For each projectile, move by speed one unit at a time within the same tick; after each unit step:
        - If out-of-bounds or obstacle, remove the projectile
        - If hitting the first non-owner live tank at that cell, reduce that tank's health by exactly 1; literally call self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id); only when health becomes zero, literally call self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id); then remove the projectile
      - Projectile same-tick movement rule: Fire first creates a projectile at barrel_ahead; tick one therefore leaves it at (3,2); tick two moves it to (4,2) and hits p2. A test expecting (2,2) after tick one is forbidden.
    - reset(self)->None: restore deep clones of the constructor-supplied initial arena and tanks (position, direction, health, speed), clear projectiles and command_queue, set scores=ScoreBoard(list(self._initial_tanks)), and next_projectile_id=0
    - winner(self)->str|None: returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks; else None
    - snapshot(self)->dict: returns only plain dict/list/scalars; arena as dict, tanks as dict of dicts with direction serialized via .name, projectiles similarly, scores as a dict with hits, kills, and per-player score mapping, and winner as scalar id or None
  - Scoring calls must be exactly: self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id) on kill only.

- Module tank_battle/configs.py:
  - build_default_demo()->Game constructs exactly Arena(8,5,[]) and two tanks: Tank("p1","P1",1,2,Direction.E,3,1) and Tank("p2","P2",6,2,Direction.W,3,1); returns Game(arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank])

- Module tank_battle/__init__.py:
  - Explicitly import and re-export exactly these public symbols: Game, Arena, Obstacle, Rect, Tank, Projectile, ScoreBoard, Direction, Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire, and build_default_demo; __all__ lists those exact names; no wildcard imports; no nested aliases such as Game.Arena; no package attribute named commands

- Module Main.py:
  - from tank_battle import build_default_demo, RotateRight
  - Function run_demo()->dict: constructs game=build_default_demo(); literally calls game.queue_command("p1", RotateRight()); then calls game.tick() exactly once; returns game.snapshot()
  - main() prints that snapshot and runs only under if __name__=="__main__"
